name: Release v1.2.3: All 6 QMOI Apps for 12+ Platforms
body:
# QMOI v1.2.3 Release

## What's Included
✅ All 6 QMOI Apps
✅ 12+ Platforms Supported
✅ 72+ Platform-Specific Builds

## Apps
- QMOI AI (v1.2.3)
- QCity (v2.0.1)
- QShare (v1.0.0)
- Yap (v1.1.0)
- QStore (v1.0.0)
- QVillage (v1.0.0)

## Platforms
**Desktop:** Windows, macOS, Linux
**Mobile:** Android, iOS
**IoT:** Raspberry Pi, Chromebook, Smart TV, Wear OS, Web/PWA, Docker

## Download & Install
1. Download the file for your platform
2. Verify SHA256 checksum (included below)
3. Run installer or execute file
4. Enjoy!

## SHA256 Checksums
See assets section for checksums.txt

- [Quick Start Guide](https://github.com/thestablekenya/qmoi-enhanced#quick-start)
- [Installation Guide](https://github.com/thestablekenya/qmoi-enhanced#installation)
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/thestablekenya/qmoi-enhanced#troubleshooting)
